title: Understanding L1 Regularization
text: L1 regularization, also known as Lasso, adds a penalty equal to the absolute value of the magnitude of coefficients to the loss function. This can lead to sparse solutions where some coefficients are exactly zero.

title: Uniqueness of L1 Regularization Solution
text: The uniqueness of the solution in L1 regularization depends on the properties of the design matrix. If the design matrix is not full rank, the solution may not be unique.

title: Full Rank Design Matrix
text: A design matrix is full rank if all its columns are linearly independent. This is a key condition for the uniqueness of solutions in linear models.

hintAnswer: Yes, the design matrix is full rank because the number of observations is greater than the number of features.
